author: copilot
subject: Implemented v5 gate coverage and direct resolution evidence
body: Schema v5 now publishes eligible and total p50 latency gate cases, signal case identifiers with baseline/current and gateway/direct spread reasons, the direct target maximum spread and worst case, and an explicit within-campaign resolution scope. Validation reconstructs both baseline-established and compared coverage fail-closed. The immutable signed v4 bundle remains backward-valid; its independent-review figures are recorded in the artifact registry and harness documentation.
